def rq3_mark_pdf(path):
    from pathlib import Path
    from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
    from pypdf.generic import NameObject, DictionaryObject, DecodedStreamObject
    reader = PdfReader(path)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages, 1):
        font = DictionaryObject({NameObject('"'"'/Type'"'"'): NameObject('"'"'/Font'"'"'), NameObject('"'"'/Subtype'"'"'): NameObject('"'"'/Type1'"'"'), NameObject('"'"'/BaseFont'"'"'): NameObject('"'"'/Helvetica'"'"')})
        page[NameObject('"'"'/Resources'"'"')] = DictionaryObject({NameObject('"'"'/Font'"'"'): DictionaryObject({NameObject('"'"'/F1'"'"'): font})})
        stream = DecodedStreamObject()
        stream.set_data(f"BT /F1 6 Tf 4 20 Td ({Path(path).name}:{i}) Tj ET".encode())
        page[NameObject('"'"'/Contents'"'"')] = stream
        writer.add_page(page)
    writer.write(path)

rq3_mark_pdf('"'"'inputs/a4.pdf'"'"')
rq3_mark_pdf('"'"'inputs/b2.pdf'"'"')' && python3 -m pdfsplitmerge merge inputs/a4.pdf inputs/b2.pdf --output output/br001/merged.pdf
